risks.title: Credit risk on private education loans
risks.score_rationale: Credit risk is central to the business model. Company bears full credit exposure on private education loans. Allowance for credit losses ($1.43B) and provision expense are key indicators of credit quality. Losses emerge as larger proportion of portfolio enters full principal and interest repayment. Management implements CECL modeling with detailed assumptions on economic variables.

risks.title: Securitization funding dependence
risks.score_rationale: Secured borrowings through Private Education Loan term securitizations total $4.87B (83% of total borrowings at December 31, 2025). Securitization is primary funding mechanism for loan originations. Market disruptions could impair funding availability and increase borrowing costs.

risks.title: Interest rate sensitivity
risks.score_rationale: Net interest margin affected by SOFR movements and changes in funding costs relative to loan yield changes. Variable-rate loans ($4.71B of $21.66B portfolio) create direct exposure to rate movements. Rising rates impact borrower repayment behavior and credit losses.

risks.title: Debt refinancing risk
risks.score_rationale: Short-term unsecured debt of $498M due November 2026. Company must refinance or repay significant near-term obligations. Credit market tightening could increase refinancing costs or limit refinancing options.

risks.title: Portfolio concentration risk
risks.score_rationale: Private education loans represent core business with portfolio of $21.66B. Limited revenue diversification outside private student lending. Strategic initiatives to develop new products are nascent. Portfolio concentrated in single market segment.

risks.title: Unfunded loan commitment reserve risk
risks.score_rationale: Company maintains reserve for unfunded loan commitments and contingent liabilities. Future loan disbursements under approved but undrawn commitments could increase credit exposure. CECL modeling of unfunded commitments involves estimation uncertainty.

risks.title: Economic sensitivity and labor market dependence
risks.score_rationale: Portfolio credit quality depends on graduate employment and wage growth. CECL models incorporate unemployment assumptions and economic forecasts. H.R.1 federal student loan reforms (effective July 2026) create demand opportunity but execution uncertainty on origination expansion.

ai_positioning.summary: SLM Corporation does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning capabilities in its 2025 Form 10-K filing. The company focuses on traditional private education lending operations.
